reading.body: the exact JSON body object (keys in wire order), {text} for a text body, or null for an empty body; a value {raw: <expression>} is computed at run time from that source expression
reading.error: body.error when the body is a JSON object with an error key
reading.message: body.message when present; absent means the old body had no message key
reading.headers: the response headers the old code sets for this answer, names lowercased; the Fetch default content-type is included for a string body with no explicit content-type (text/plain;charset=UTF-8) and for Response.json (application/json); a thrown refusal carries the headers of its dispatcher's catch
reading.headersFrom: headers whose value is computed at run time, as the old source expression (for example retry-after: String(admission.retryAfterSeconds)); a header added only under a condition is given as the guarded statement; the key * names a header source the extractor could not expand
reading.key: the answer's name in apps/<area>/src/client/refusals.vibe; one name per distinct answer (status, body and headers) across the area
reading.condition: the source condition that selects this answer (nearest enclosing if, ternary, case or catch)
reading.methods: on otherMethods rows: the request methods, among those no route row of this path covers, that reach this answer
reading.at: file:line in the old tree where the answer is written
reading.via: the call chain from the route's dispatch into a shared helper, when the answer is not in the dispatch range itself

thrownErrors.replace: Every thrown failure answers the dispatcher's fixed response; thrown refusals inside the route never reach the client and are omitted from this row.
thrownErrors.uncaught: A thrown failure escapes the Worker's fetch handler; the runtime answers 500.

reading.sources: the dispatch ranges of the old tree that select and serve this route
reading.calledFrom: file:line of an old Worker that calls this route over a service binding (the scheduled payments dispatcher)
reading.scope: rows are every answer reachable from the route's dispatch range through resolved calls, for this route's own method and path: every if, ternary, && / || operand, switch case and early return between the dispatch and the answer is evaluated with request.method and the request path fixed to this route (a parameter segment matches any value), and an answer behind a condition that is false for the route, or after a statement that always returns for it, is dropped; a shared helper's refusal is listed for each route that calls it, with its condition
